decisions.reason: As a flagship automation module that directly supports the firm's integrated and future-ready precast plant concept, the combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot should remain in the portfolio.
The automatic de-shuttering robot still serves customers who need a modular or more stepwise automation investment than the combined system, so it is worth retaining.
The automatic shuttering robot continues to complement both standalone and integrated plant configurations, which fits the firm's broad-range machinery strategy.

The combined magazining cleaning and plotting machine broadens the firm's established production-equipment offer and, as a new multi-model line, is likely to be developed further rather than withdrawn.
Production analysis software strengthens the firm's integrated equipment-plus-controls-plus-service proposition and is strategically important for more automated precast production.
